[tsa-a21-v01] Thus the whole, permanent, occasion-bound rite is established.

[tsa-a21-v10] In which firm-establishment-made transaction, that very I am fearless.

[tsa-a21-v11] Then you will be, according-as establishment-attained, Parama-Siva.

[tsa-a21-v12] In own-firm-establishment-made transaction, the world is without doubt.

[tsa-a21-v13] Then becomes, established-through-recognitions-crossed, Parama-Siva.

[tsa-a21-v02] Now the authority of this very tradition is stated.

[tsa-a21-v03] Therein — in the universe made of mere consciousness alone, and in consciousness of vimarśa-nature, and in vimarśa's sound-nature established — of the world-established thing and its manifold act-fruit connections: whatever contemplation that is, that indeed is scripture. Whole scripture-structure, in fact, is one-fruit-attaining, by one-duty-declaration alone; but there, by the Lord's necessity-power-glory, people's establishment is in each part.

[tsa-a21-v04] Some are established in Veda-tradition-and-rest scriptures, in the self of Māyā-fitting-difference-contemplation; others just that kind by liberation-claim, in Sāṃkhya-Vaiṣṇava-scriptures-and-rest; others in the essence of reflecting separated Śiva-nature, in Śaiva-Siddhānta-and-rest; others in the essence of reflecting all-pervasive Lordhood, in Maṅgala-and-rest scriptures; but some very rare, in the self reflecting the Lord's own nature bound by exhaustive limitation-free-bliss-supreme-truth-made-of-consciousness, in the order of blessed Trika scripture; but some by earlier-earlier-abandonment order or by transcendence — thus in this way one-fruit-attainment from one tradition alone.

[tsa-a21-v05] In the difference-doctrine too, even of all scriptures, in being one Lord's work, authority stands for now: from being based on authority, partial agreement's not-being-denied, and unstopped operation being equal, mutual contradiction from subject-difference is powerless.

[tsa-a21-v06] Like the brahma-killing-prohibition, ritual-distinction and ritual-excellence — in its absence somewhere being-unqualified: same, like the ashrama-distinction; and from fruit-excellence, excellence just-there. In Upaniṣad-Bhāgavata, in distinct-authorship even, being-made-by-all-knowers is conceivable here — from conjunction of meaning in what-is-said-and-beyond. In eternality even, scriptures' recognition: for-now necessarily-reached, from being-rooted-in-inference-elimination-perception-and-rest — their authority. 'I see gold [and] silver' — indeed, recognition is scripture, through goldsmith-and-others' recognition. Some with-seen-fruit a desirer enjoys: child's engagement just by recognition, not-by-inference-and-elimination — then, from those two's absence, in youth its presence is powerless. But rooting recognition, he — let him be — for someone, some work: some giving fruits of invisible-impotence-nature-dissolution-solitude, some of equality-with-Siva, some ending-in-oneness — she severally many-kinded: thus in a world filled with many recognitions, whoever to-be, he just such recognition by force indeed assumes, ending-in-the-heart.

[tsa-a21-v07] Thus for the empty being's surplus verbal-connections — any of their recognition taken as proof — scripture-authority is to be granted; that scripture is to be relied on where excellent fruit is: enough by another.

[tsa-a21-v08] By consciousness-light-supreme-truth-nature, as indeed shines, touches also, so — discriminating.

[tsa-a21-v09] Being, take refuge in the scripture — essence-of-all-made-consciousness-reflection-vimarśa, O Unsurpassable-self.
